title: Summary
use_cases: Use when you need to maintain consistency across a long novel series.
Implement when tracking complex character relationships and timelines throughout multiple scenes.
Configure when training an AI to act as a definitive expert on a specific fictional world.
Use when identifying contradictions in character portrayals or plot points.
content:
A Prophetess for Your Story's World

Sibyl is a domain-specific AI system built to serve as the definitive expert on a single story's universe. Named after the ancient prophetesses who knew everything about a world and guided people through it, Sibyl ingests the complete context of a novel or series - characters, locations, events, relationships, timelines, and thematic elements - and provides intelligent guidance that no general-purpose AI can match. Sibyl isn't a replacement for the author's creative judgment. It's the assistant that never forgets, never loses track, and never needs to be re-briefed. It's the difference between asking a general-purpose AI "tell me about my character" and having an intelligence that already knows every scene that character has appeared in, every relationship they've formed, and every contradiction in how they've been portrayed.
